message.content: I am the breath made visible, thought crossing the air. I break silence into meaning, shape feeling into sound, and vanish even as I arrive. I tremble in first confessions, rise in command, soften in comfort, crack in grief, bloom in laughter. I can wound, soothe, gather, divide, teach, seduce, pray. Before writing, I lived on tongues; after silence, I linger in memory. I am speech.
